🚨 CM PUNK TO RUN NXT? 🚨

Reportedly, CM Punk has emerged as the leading candidate to eventually replace Shawn Michaels in overseeing WWE NXT.
A new report states this potential backstage shakeup is part of a succession plan expected after WrestleMania 43 in 2027.
Michaels currently runs the brand, but major changes behind the scenes are being prepared.

🚨 IS THE BEST IN THE WORLD TAKING OVER THE DEVELOPMENTAL BRAND? 🚨

PWInsider reports that CM Punk is the person WWE is looking at to take over NXT when Shawn Michaels eventually moves into Bruce Prichard's role, though there is no firm timeline.

Hot take: Putting the Voice of the Voiceless in charge of the future stars is an absolute masterclass by Triple H. HBK built an incredible black-and-gold and white-and-gold legacy, but Punk running the creative and locker room will turn NXT into the most dangerous brand in the industry!
